lessons_learned: Lesson: In React functional components, all hooks (including useMemo) must be declared unconditionally at the top of the component before any early returns (like if (isLoading) return <PageSkeleton />). Placing useMemo after early returns violates the Rules of Hooks and causes runtime crash 'Rendered more hooks than during the previous render' when state transitions from loading to loaded.

Prevention: When auditing and intercepting mock API routes in Playwright or testing suites, specific sub-resource routes (e.g. /review-workspace, /view-url, /file) must be evaluated before generic parent item matchers (e.g. /api/submissions/sub-test-1) to avoid premature request swallowing.
